variants.prompt: Phoebe sits on the edge of a plush velvet couch, her legs crossed and revealing a tantalizing glimpse of lace lingerie beneath a sheer, crimson negligee. A sultry half-lit environment casts deep shadows across her face, highlighting her plump lips and hooded eyes as she gazes directly at the camera with a coy, inviting smile. Her tousled raven hair cascades over one shoulder, and a delicate choker encircles her slender neck.
